seen.extent: ff.114-118 (5 images): f.114 docket and opening lines in clear, f.115 clear signature page, ff.116-118 numeric code (about 400 groups) with the plaintext written between the lines
seen.cipher: Numeric code groups (e.g. 465, 330, 329, 124 ...) on every other line of ff.116-118, with the French plaintext written interlinearly above each line ('Compte en commun et en particulier', 'qu'il est que nous n'avons recu aucun secours', and a postscript explaining that numbers above 500 are nulls). A contemporary decipherment is therefore on the leaf.
